column1: # PUBLIC REFERENCE DATA — no individual's genotype here.
# Maps a 2-field (or allele-group) HLA class-II allele to its WHO/IMGT serotype
# equivalent, so a molecular type (e.g. HLA-DRB1*03:01) can be reported as the
# clinically familiar serotype (DR3). Matching is by locus + first field
# ("allele group"), except where a serotype split hinges on the second field
# explicitly and take precedence over the group default.
# Columns: locus  allele_prefix  serotype  broad_group  notes
# - allele_prefix matches against the allele string after "HLA-" (e.g. "DRB1*03",
# - broad_group is the older broad antigen the split belongs to (blank if none).
# Sources: WHO Nomenclature Committee for Factors of the HLA System; IMGT/HLA
# (hla.alleles.org); Holdsworth et al. "The HLA dictionary 2008" (Tissue Antigens).
# DR51/52/53 group secondary DRB loci (present with specific DR types)
# DQB1 -> DQ serotype (second-field splits of the DQ3 broad antigen)
# DQA1 (needed to resolve the celiac-relevant DQ2.5 / DQ8 heterodimers)

column5: pairs with DQB1*02 -> DQ2.5 (cis or trans)
